key_insight: This paper is a publisher correction, not a new model result. It clarifies the published record for "Quantum neural operators with implicit quadratic frame and expressivity advantages," ensuring the article metadata and citation details are accurate.
problem_solved: It addresses publication inaccuracies associated with the original article, helping readers, databases, and citation tools rely on the correct version of record.
method: Issue a formal correction notice linked to the original Nature Machine Intelligence paper.
Update the publication record and DOI-related metadata so the corrected version is clearly identifiable.
Preserve continuity with the original research while documenting the amendment transparently.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, the main value is citation reliability and record integrity. Accurate publication metadata helps researchers track the right paper, avoid confusion, and trust downstream indexing and literature review workflows.
